NEW BUSINESS

1.  REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK CAPITAL
  IMPROVEMENT PLAN TO IMPROVE CITY STREETS, FACILITIES AND TRAFFIC
  SAFETY IN THE COMMUNITY
  Staff recommends City Council 1) authorize staff to complete a bid package and
  advertise for construction bids the proposed street improvements consisting of overlays,
  chip seals and slurry seals estimated to cost $4,136,000, except advertisement of bids
  for the Ramona project, would be done upon receipt of clearance from CalTrans; 2)
  authorize staff to prepare bid packages and proceed with completing priority street
  repairs per Attachment C of the staff report estimated to cost $250,000; 3) authorize staff
  to prepare procurement documents to implement the proposed Traffic Safety
  Enhancements included in Attachment D of the staff report estimated at $382,000.
  $160,000 of these improvements (6 speed feed back signs and Francisquito Avenue
  signal enhancements) to be procured through a change order under recommendation 7;
  4) authorize staff to set aside funds for the Walkability Program in the amount of
  $200,000; 5) authorize the Finance Director to allocate Proposition C Funds for the
  design and construction of the Transit Center Parking Facility in the amount of
  $2,500,000; 6) authorize staff to prepare the bid package and advertise for construction
  bids the second phase of the Morgan Park improvements using already approved
  budgeted funds; and 7) authorize staff to approve a change order for the Francisquito
  Rehabilitation contractor, Hardy and Harper in the amount of $250,000, to include Traffic
  Safety Enhancements (signal enhancements $91,000; speed feed back signs $69,000)
  and urgent street repairs in the amount of $90,000 per Attachment B of the staff report.
